scripts.zip: rm -f lambda.zip && zip -r lambda.zip dist package.json
scripts.build:zip: bun run build && bun run zip
scripts.deploy: aws lambda update-function-code --function-name n8n-workflow-poller-dev --zip-file fileb://lambda.zip --region ap-south-1
scripts.deploy:full: bun run build:zip && bun run deploy
scripts.build:lambda-zip-windows: bun run build && Compress-Archive -Path dist,package.json -DestinationPath lambda.zip -Force
